profile.headline: Computer Engineer and Web Developer
profile.summary:
With little to no experience with Ruby on Rails and without any idea how javascript really works, let alone Backbone.js (a popular javascript framework), I put out hours of my own personal time to create what is now an on-going project called KickTheList.com. 

I have always been fascinated by the idea that engineers can create possibly anything they want all within a few keystroke. Now I can create a simple Web-application and launch it within a day using HTML, CSS and Ruby on Rails. Aside from my passion for creating products for users, I also am intrigue in programming designs and concepts. During my internship at Extreme Network Inc., I got to experience developing a network protocol into the existing framework. This gave me insight on how professional C program can be structure and lead many useful coding practice and debugging techniques using Unix, Vim, Cscope, and GDB. My stay at Cisco system not only taught me the skills necessary to test Cisco prototypical routers, but also the leadership and management necessary to deploy a successful software product. 

I recently graduated and received a B.S for Computer Engineering from San Jose State University and would always remember the professors, faculties members, co-workers, colleagues and family that helped me get there. Though I have graduated from college, the learning process never stops. I am continuing to expand my technical knowledge, my leadership and management skills, and improving the overall qualities that would make me a great person. To achieve this, I am currently spending an ample amount of my time expanding my knowledge on technologies that will help accelerate my development with my current project KickTheList.com. I am also looking into opportunities that will help me learn from more experience developers and possibly give something back to the community and to those who helped me along the way.

Specialties: HTML, CSS, Ruby on Rails, Verilog, C programming

positions.description:
K9 Prototype Board Tracking Software
•	Lead a team to restructure the software development process to successfully deliver a product, which was facing ongoing prolonged deployment date, with essential features to manage board distributions.
Optical Design Verification Test (ODVT)
•	Performed optical test on Cisco prototypical board to meet IEEE standards.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Develop a network protocol on layer 3 switches to analyze incoming traffic to detect a loop in the network.
•	Debug ISIS network protocol utilizing tools such as rGDB and Cscope to pinpoint the source of the problem that lead to a successful bug fix.

projects.title: KickTheList.com
projects.description: KickTheList.com is a web application that allow users to post things they want to do, share it, connect with friends and/or others with similar interest, and receive deals to help complete their list. HTML, CSS, Ruby on Rails, Backbone.js, MySQL, Apache.

projects.title: Entusic.com
projects.description: Entusic.com is a web platform that allows local bands, performers and artist to raise funds for their events. Ruby on Rails, HTML, CSS, Apache, MySQL.
